messages.subject: Project Umbra - Licence Agreement v3 (Licensor response)
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

v3 attached responding to your mark-up. We've compromised to a £1.25m upfront and 7.5% royalty, an 18-month warranty, and a liability cap at the greater of £3m / 150% with a £5m IP indemnity cap. We've reverted the term to five years and reinstated non-transferability while accepting your 'even as to the Licensor' exclusivity. We think this is the deal.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
